title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.
evidence_note: 回溯性全國連續案例系列，無對照組；部落格另引用 Cochrane 回顧等支持性文獻。

ethics_flags.note: 自傷後接觸服務是介入窗口，需有系統化的風險評估、安全計畫與快速後續追蹤。
refs: 危機處理｜自殺與自傷風險

caution: 案例系列只看自殺身亡者，無法估計個別自傷青少年的風險，不能當作風險預測工具。
brief_zh: 49% 有自傷史、26% 近期自傷
近期自傷者 60% 在三個月內接觸過心理健康服務
51% 無自傷紀錄 → 預防不能只靠自傷史篩檢
brief_en: 60% with recent self-harm had service contact within 3 months
51% had no recorded self-harm → screening by history alone is insufficient
supervision_questions: 青少年因自傷求助時，我們的評估除了行為本身，還涵蓋哪些關係與環境壓力？
我們的服務能否做到 48 小時內的後續聯絡？卡在哪裡？
對沒有自傷史卻有近期逆境的青少年，如何提高警覺而不過度病理化？

posts.title: Self-Harm in Young People: Turning Contact with Services into Opportunities for Care
posts.content: ACAMH 部落格評介英國 10–19 歲自殺身亡者的全國案例系列（Aggarwal 等，2025）：近半曾有自傷紀錄，近期自傷者中六成在死亡前三個月曾接觸心理健康服務，作者提出評估與後續照護建議。

related.title_zh: 青少年「失眠」可能是晝夜節律延遲：挪威研究近九成有相位後移指標
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格整理挪威 3,867 名高中生的研究（Arnesen 等，2025）：34.5% 符合失眠標準，但其中 88.4% 呈現晝夜節律延遲的指標。作者建議評估上學日與假日的睡眠時間差、延後就寢是否改善入睡、週末補眠等；失眠以 CBT-I 處理，節律延遲則考慮光照、褪黑激素時機與逐步提前起床時間，而非只叫孩子早點上床。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog summarises a study of 3,867 Norwegian high-school students (Arnesen et al., 2025): 34.5% met insomnia criteria, yet 88.4% of these showed indicators of circadian delay. The author recommends assessing school-day vs free-day sleep timing, response to later bedtimes and weekend catch-up sleep; CBT-I for insomnia, and light, melatonin timing and gradual wake-time advances for circadian delay rather than simply earlier bedtimes.

related.title_zh: Anna Freud 的校本 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 進入 30 間學校做 RCT
related.title_en: Anna Freud's MindWorks school CBT programme enters RCT
related.summary_zh: MindWorks 是 Anna Freud 開發、以系統取向為基礎的 CBT 計畫，對象為 11–16 歲學生，由受訓的教育心理健康從業員等在一個學期內提供，並把家長與學校職員納入。計畫由 Youth Endowment Fund 資助，2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間主流與另類學校推行，Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗。
related.summary_en: MindWorks, a systemic CBT programme for 11–16-year-olds developed by Anna Freud, launches in 30 English schools from September 2026 and is being evaluated in an RCT of 720 children by the Ending Youth Violence Lab.

related.title_zh: 焦慮家長的自助線上課程能預防孩子焦慮嗎？1,811 人 RCT 的小效果與低完成率
related.title_en: Online program for anxious parents prevents child anxiety
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介一項平行組隨機對照試驗（Dunn 等，2024）：1,811 名高焦慮家長（子女 2–11 歲）分為無人引導的線上模組組或控制組，模組每單元約 20 分鐘，涵蓋減少迴避、情緒教練、減少過度保護等。六個月時介入組子女的家長評焦慮顯著較低（d = −0.16），家長焦慮也下降；但約 32% 完成兩個以上模組、約 19% 全部完成。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a parallel-group RCT (Dunn et al., 2024) in which 1,811 highly anxious parents of children aged 2–11 were randomised to unguided online modules (about 20 minutes each, covering avoidance, emotion coaching, overprotection) or control. At six months, parent-reported child anxiety was significantly lower (d = −0.16) and parental anxiety also fell, but only about 32% completed two or more modules and about 19% completed all.
